exercises.question: A car travels 3 km East and then 4 km North. Find the magnitude of its displacement.
exercises.question_amharic: አንድ መኪና 3 ኪ.ሜ ወደ ምስራቅ ከዚያም 4 ኪ.ሜ ወደ ሰሜን ተጓዘ። የመፈናቀሉን መጠን ፈልጉ።
exercises.step_by_step_explanation: 1. East and North directions are perpendicular (90 degrees).\n2. Apply R = √(3² + 4²) = √(9 + 16) = √25.\n3. Resultant displacement is 5 km.
exercises.step_by_step_explanation_amharic: 1. East and North directions are perpendicular (90 degrees).\n2. Apply R = √(3² + 4²) = √(9 + 16) = √25.\n3. Resultant displacement is 5 km.
